editorial: Medellin is the city of eternal spring, but Cartagena can be sweltering, so choose a time that makes for a comfortable visit to the Caribbean coast.

We visited in October, in the middle of the wet season (May to November). In Cartagena, they may as well call it sweat season. The heat and humidity was unlike anything we had experienced, and stepping out during the day was a health hazard. Medellin, of course was perfectly pleasant.
So we certainly recommend going during the milder months of the dry season (December to April).
